question: Who of the following was elected as President of the Constituent Assembly of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajendra Prasad**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Rajendra Prasad** was elected as the President of the Constituent Assembly of India.
 
• The Constituent Assembly was responsible for drafting the Constitution of India.
 
• Dr. Rajendra Prasad played a crucial role in the framing of the Indian Constitution and was a respected leader and freedom fighter.
 
• He later became the first President of independent India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Constituent Assembly of India was formed in 1946 to draft the Indian Constitution.
 
• It was chaired by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, who is often referred to as the principal architect of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The Assembly consisted of prominent leaders from various political backgrounds, including Jawaharlal Nehru, Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, and Maulana Abul Kalam Azad.
 
• The Constitution of India was adopted on 26th November 1949 and came into effect on 26th January 1950.
 
• Dr. Rajendra Prasad's leadership was instrumental in guiding the debates and discussions within the Assembly to a successful conclusion.
